row.name: Little Bear Child Care Center, INC.

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: One of five children's files evaluated did not have current immunization records available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Infants sleep in Designated Crib, Cot, Bed, or Mat: Two infants were observed to be asleep in places other than their crib. One infant was asleep in a swing and the other was asleep in a Boppy pillow on the floor.    Note: This was corrected at inspection when the caregivers placed them in their cribs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infants sleep in Designated Crib, Cot, Bed, or Mat (26 TAC §746.2424)

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: Cleaning supplies were stored under the hand washing sink accessible to children in the toddler room.    Note: This was corrected at inspection when director removed the chemicals.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Storage of Medication - Inaccessible to Children: A bottle of cough syrup was stored in a child's personal cubby.     Note: This was corrected at inspection when the director removed the medication from the cubby.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Storage of Medication - Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3807(1))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Pinch, Crush, or Shear Points: The piece of lumbar at the platform of the car metal equipment play is broken and did not hold on weight.   Note: This was corrected when a caregiver removed the play equipment from the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Pinch, Crush, or Shear Points (26 TAC §746.4601(7))

occurrences.finding: Medication No Longer Used: There were nine medications that were expired in the medicine box.     Note: This was corrected when the director dispose the expired medication.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication No Longer Used (26 TAC §746.3809)

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - School Information for School-age Child: One of the ten children files was missing school-age information.    One of the ten children files was missing food allergy information.    Five of the ten children files were missing special care statements.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - School Information for School-age Child (26 TAC §746.605(14))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages: The caregiver in the PreK classroom stated there were 14 children when it was verified there were 15 children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: One of the ten staff records were missing an affidavit and photo ID.     NOTE: Corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Medication No Longer Used: Two medications stored in the office were expired.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication No Longer Used (26 TAC §746.3809)

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: Fire inspection was last conducted on 7.3.23.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Document Test Date, Battery Installation Date, and Staff Name Testing and Installation: No documentation for the carbon monoxide was available at the time of inspection.     NOTE: This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Document Test Date, Battery Installation Date, and Staff Name Testing and Installation (26 TAC §746.5537(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Five of the ten children files were missing updated immunization records.     Four of the ten children records were missing healthcare statements.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: Four fire extinguishers in the operation had not been serviced in over one year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The emergency practices log reflects that there has been no fire drill done since July/2023.    Only two severe weather/lockdown drills were conducted during the last calendar year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Two of the ten children's files reviewed did not have the health statement signed by a physican within twelve months of enrollment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: A child with an allergy did not have an allergy action plan readily available for review in their file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The last fire drill documented was in July 2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Posted in Each Room: The emergecny evacuation diagrams were not posted in each classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Posted in Each Room (26 TAC §746.5207(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: Eight of the ten personnel files reviewed did not have a notarized affidavit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: Several trash cans in the operation containing food scraps did not have lids
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Four of the ten children's files reviewed did not contain updated immunization records
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The previous fire inspection occurred on 10/27/2020 which is past the required annual timeframe.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: In the infant room, there were two children seated in a toddler table and the safety straps were not secured.     This was corrected at inspection when the children were removed from the toddler table.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: In the outdoor play area, there was one board missing in the fence which left a gap large enough that a child could become entangled or escape through the fence.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: A child found a pill on the floor that was prescribed for an adult, and put it in their mouth.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: During the investigation an individual was observed  in direct care of children without receiving background check eligibility notification. This was corrected when the employee was removed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Prescription medication was placed in a caregivers pocket that was unsecured which caused the medication to fall onto the floor making it accessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited: Neglect occurred when a child found a pill on the floor that was prescribed for an adult, and put it in their mouth.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))
